results.use_case: list cloudflare dns records and zones
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required (if zone_id unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Discover the target zone using CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES (or CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_ZONES) and capture data.result[].id; paginate via data.result_info.total_pages.

[Required] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate/search records using CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_DNS_RECORDS (filter by name/type; capture data.result[].id; use data.result_info.total_pages and count/total_count to decide create vs update vs delete).

[Optional (if exact-name search is empty but a record is expected)] [Step]: Broaden discovery using CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_DNS_RECORDS (e.g., filter by type) to avoid creating duplicates under a different name.

[Optional (for write operations only)] [Step]: Confirm the full intended record shape (type/name/content, ttl, proxied, priority when applicable) and whether replacement/deletion is intended before mutating.
[Optional (if adding a new record)] [Step]: Create the record using CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD (or CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_CREATE_DNS_RECORD) with zone_id + record details.
[Optional (if modifying an existing record)] [Step]: Update by overwriting using CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_OVERWRITE_DNS_RECORD (or CLOUDFLARE_UPDATE_DNS_RECORD) with the complete desired record payload.
[Optional (if removing a record)] [Step]: Delete using CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_DELETE_DNS_RECORD (use record id; confirm irreversible change).
[Required] [Next Step]: Verify end state by re-listing using CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_DNS_RECORDS (confirm new values or absence).
[Optional (if third-party verification is required)] [Next Step]: Add a TXT verification record using CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_CREATE_DNS_RECORD (same zone_id).

[Optional (if auth/connection errors or data.success=false)] [Fallback]: Re-run the failing action with the API-key variant (CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_ZONES / CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_CREATE_DNS_RECORD / CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_OVERWRITE_DNS_RECORD / CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_DELETE_DNS_RECORD) and re-verify via CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_DNS_RECORDS.
known_pitfalls: [CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS] May return authentication failures (e.g., code 10000 or errors[0].code=9106); use CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_DNS_RECORDS for discovery.
[CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_DNS_RECORDS] zone_id cannot be empty (validation like “at least 1 character”); obtain it first via zone listing.
[CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_DNS_RECORDS] Exact-name filtering can return an empty result set with success=true; rely on result_info.count/total_count to decide next action.
[CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD] May fail with “No active connection found for toolkit(s)”; use CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_CREATE_DNS_RECORD.
[CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_OVERWRITE_DNS_RECORD] Overwrite requires the full desired record; missing fields can unintentionally reset ttl (often to 1/auto) or other settings.

CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES.description: Lists, searches, sorts, and filters zones in the authenticated account. Use `page`/`per_page` to paginate; check `result_info.total_pages` in the response to iterate all pages. Does not return DNS records — extract `zone_id` from results before passing to zone-scoped tools (DNS, firewall, etc.). Only zones delegated to Cloudflare nameservers appear; empty results indicate scope or delegation constraints, not errors.

name.description: A domain name. Optional filter operators can be provided to extend and refine the search.

match.description: Whether to match all search requirements or at least one (any).

name.description: An account Name. Optional filter operators can be provided to extend and refine the search

account.description: Filter zones by account ID and/or account name.

CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_DNS_RECORDS.description: List, search, sort, and filter DNS records for a Cloudflare zone. Use this tool to retrieve DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, etc.) for a zone. Supports filtering by record type, name, content, and proxy status. Results are paginated; use page and per_page parameters for large record sets. Requires a valid zone_id which can be obtained from the List Zones action.

name.description: Filter by exact DNS record name (e.g., 'example.com' or 'sub.example.com'). Case-insensitive.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (minimum: 1, default: 1).

type.description: Filter by DNS record type (e.g., A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX).

match.description: Logical operator for filters: 'all' (AND) matches all criteria, 'any' (OR) matches any criterion. Default: 'all'.

order.description: Field to order results by. Default ordering is by type.

search.description: Human-readable search query to filter records by name, content, or other properties simultaneously.

content.description: Filter by exact record content (e.g., IP address for A records, target hostname for CNAME). Case-insensitive.

proxied.description: Filter by Cloudflare proxy status. True = proxied through Cloudflare, False = DNS only.

zone_id.description: Zone identifier (32-character hex string) to list DNS records for.

per_page.description: Number of DNS records per page (minimum: 1, maximum: 5000, default: 100).

direction.description: Sort direction: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending. Default: 'asc'.

CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD.description: Tool to create a new DNS record within a specific zone. Requires write privileges and makes live changes to the zone. Use after obtaining the zone ID via CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES to programmatically add DNS entries.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; minimum 1. Use 1 for automatic TTL

data.description: Additional data object for record types like SRV, LOC, or CAA

name.description: DNS record name (e.g., example.com or www.example.com)

tags.description: List of tags to associate with the record

comment.description: Human-readable comment for the DNS record

content.description: DNS record content (e.g., IP for A records)

proxied.description: Whether the record is receiving Cloudflare performance and security benefits

priority.description: Priority for MX, SRV, and URI records; required for those types

zone_identifier.description: Zone identifier (UUID) where the DNS record will be created

CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_ZONES.description: Tool to list, search, sort, and filter Cloudflare zones. Use when you need to retrieve a paginated list of zones available to the authenticated user.

name.description: A domain name; supports the same operators as account.name.

match.description: Whether to match any or all search requirements (default: all).

account.name.description: Account name; supports operators: equal (default), not_equal, starts_with, ends_with, contains, starts_with_case_sensitive, ends_with_case_sensitive, contains_case_sensitive.
